name: @pipedog/piper
description: Piper text-to-speech for pipedog: a port of Pipecat's PiperTTSService (Piper ONNX voices run locally through @pipedog/onnx, espeak-ng phonemization) and PiperHttpTTSService (a Piper HTTP server, over fetch).

needs.all: PiperTTSService: onnxruntime-node (or onnxruntime-web) and @echogarden/espeak-ng-emscripten, plus a Piper voice (20-136 MB) downloaded on first use. PiperHttpTTSService: only fetch and a Piper HTTP server.
needs.workerd: PiperHttpTTSService only (PiperTTSService needs a filesystem and exceeds Workers' limits).
